title: Docs: Markus render binary is not PyPI markus
description:
Ryan 2026-09-09 dogfood: docs and onboarding do not distinguish the Kanbus Markus render binary from the unrelated PyPI package named markus.

## Problem

Agents and contributors may pip install markus expecting the render toolchain, or search docs for Markus and land on the wrong project.

## Expected

Documentation should name the render binary explicitly, state that it is not the PyPI markus package, and point to the correct install or build path for the Kanbus renderer.
